# SimpleMAF

> Mohamed (@simplemaf on TikTok) explains AI, consumer tech, and money in
> short videos, and ships private iOS apps. This site is his home page.

Topics covered in videos: AI model news and concepts explained plainly
(distillation, on-device AI), consumer tech pricing and value (iPhone leasing
vs buying, folding phone prices), and the privacy fine print of financial
products (cash-back cards, banking apps).

Apps (all data stays on the user's device, none collect data):
- Stockd, smart grocery lists: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stockd-smart-grocery-lists/id6761667432
- Cadence, shift calendar for rotation work: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cadence-am-i-on-or-off/id6786077175
- Prayer Windows, honest prayer times: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/prayer-windows-salah-times/id6793598476
- Quran, the Madinah mushaf with word-by-word audio (Android version coming soon): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quran-madinah-mushaf-audio/id6809227627
- Sweep, street sweeping alerts for San Francisco and Oakland: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sweep-street-sweeping-alerts/id6807645821
- Tiny Critic, a baby food diary written as one-star reviews: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiny-critic-baby-food-diary/id6812938189
